## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Bāhiramātikā* (Dt 1.5) is a structural section of the *Dhātukathā* ("Discourse on Elements"), the third book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Rendered in translation as the "External Tables" by U Nārada and The Mūla Paṭṭhāna Sayadaw, it serves alongside the *Abbhantara-mātikā* ("Internal Tables") as part of the matrices that underpin the analytical treatments and classifications found within the treatise [Discourse on Elements (Dhatukatha)_U Narada and Mula Patthana Sayadaw, tr., 1962, 2007].
Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus records any internal Pali text-reuse matches or cross-language parallels for this section [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation in one language [SuttaCentral].
